description: This file defines the 'StreamingSession' class, which encapsulates the data and behaviors concerning a streaming session, including namespaces, predicates for filtering 'Thing' objects, extra fields handling, and merging of signals and 'Thing' information.

classes.name: StreamingSession
classes.description: Immutable class representing a streaming session with associated namespaces, filtering criteria, and optional extra fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new StreamingSession instance with specified namespaces, optional event filter criteria, and optional extra fields.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces associated with this streaming session.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the extra fields selector if any are set.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtra
methods.description: Merges thing information from a signal with extra fields, returning a 'Thing' object; returns an empty 'Thing' if no information is available.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Tests whether a given 'Thing' matches the session's defined filter predicate.
